title: Uncontrolled Blood
summary: Surging to 25% Synchronization, Ha-Jun transforms into a horned berserk demon and violently overpowers Rank-A Captain Baek. On the verge of an accidental slaughter, Min-Jae's desperate cry reaches Ha-Jun's human soul—allowing him to redirect the hellfire blast and shatter the campus dome.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands inside a crater of swirling black-violet hellfire; his school blazer is shredded, revealing glossy obsidian crystalline scales across his chest.
Two curved, razor-sharp obsidian horns crown Ha-Jun's head, crackling with violet lightning and drifting purple embers.
Extreme macro: All human eye whites are gone—only pitch-black sclera with burning crimson-violet supernova rings remain.

dialogue.text: Insaaniyat khatam ho chuki thi... sirf shaitan bacha tha.

panels.shot: mark of death vaporizing into gold dust
panels.action: The golden execution cross branded into his crystalline gauntlet cracks and disintegrates into harmless golden dust under monstrous mana.
Captain Baek takes an involuntary backward step, his massive claymore shivering in his trembling palms: '25% Synchronization already?!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Yeh koi aam bacha nahi hai... yeh True Monarch hai!

panels.action: Ha-Jun tilts his head; when he exhales, superheated violet plasma mist billows from his teeth, melting the wet turf into liquid slag.
Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN! APNE HOSH MEIN RAHO! AGAR ASMODAIUS NE TUMHARA DIMAAG CHHEEN LIYA TOH POORA SHEHAR RAAKH HO JAYEGA!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Hosh mein aao! Poora shehar tabah ho jayega!

panels.action: Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human soul is trapped in a screaming crimson vortex, desperately fighting against demonic instinct.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ruk jao... mujhe kisi ko nahi maarna...!

panels.action: Ha-Jun vanishes with zero wind resistance or acoustic tell; the air simply implodes where he was standing.
Ha-Jun appears inches from Baek's face, his jagged crystalline claw swinging horizontally with decapitating force.
Baek throws his holy claymore across his chest in a desperate flat parry; the collision rings like a church bell.

panels.shot: holy wings shattering into light feathers
panels.action: The concussive shockwave completely shatters both of Captain Baek's golden holy wings into thousands of dissolving feathers.
Baek's 220-pound armored body is blasted backward through the brick wall, through two classrooms, and out onto the tennis courts.
Baek crashes into the chain-link fence, tearing the steel mesh; he coughs a heavy mouthful of blood, ceremonial coat shredded.
Ha-Jun descends from the sky like a fallen black star, trailing twin ribbons of violet fire and black lightning.
Ha-Jun lands and slams his palm down: Dozens of 15-foot crystalline blood spears erupt from the concrete, pinning Baek's limbs and armor.
Baek hangs pinned against the fence by blood spears, claymore knocked 20 feet away, blood dripping from his lips.
Ha-Jun stands over Baek, condensing a pulsating sphere of black-and-violet Abyssal Hellfire in his palm, aimed at Baek's forehead.
Baek looks directly into the hellfire sphere, refusing to beg: 'Mujhe maar daalo, demon. Lekin Bureau tumhe kabhi nahi chhodega.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain_baek
dialogue.text: Mujhe maar daalo. Bureau tumhe dhoond nikalega.

panels.shot: min-jae limping onto tennis court shouting
panels.action: Min-Jae limps through the torn fence, clutching his bruised ribs, crying through his cracked glasses: 'HA-JUN! RUK JAO!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN! RUK JAO! USSE MAT MAARO!!

panels.shot: horned head turning alien cold stare
panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly turns his horned head toward Min-Jae; his pitch-black eyes look completely cold, predatory, devoid of human recognition.
The condensed hellfire sphere in Ha-Jun's gauntlet unconsciously swivels, aiming directly at Min-Jae's chest!
Min-Jae trembles violently but doesn't run: 'Ha-Jun... yaad karo tum kaun ho! Apne bhai ke vaade ko yaad karo!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: APNE BHAI KE VAADE KO YAAD KARO!!

panels.action: Extreme close-up: At the word 'Bhai', Ha-Jun's crimson rings violently contract; a jolt of human agony rips through his soul.
Inside his mind, Ha-Jun's human self grabs the burning bloodline core with both hands, pulling it away from the abyss.
Ha-Jun wrenches his gauntlet straight up toward the heavens, unleashing the hellfire sphere in a colossal vertical laser pillar!

panels.shot: purification dome shattering golden glass rain
panels.action: The hellfire pillar pierces the golden Anti-Demon Purification Dome above the university, shattering the entire barrier into rain of golden glass shards.

panels.shot: obsidian horns dissolving back into skull
panels.action: The razor obsidian horns dissolve into violet smoke; the crystalline scales sink back beneath Ha-Jun's pale, trembling human skin.

panels.shot: collapsing on knees brown eyes return
panels.action: Ha-Jun collapses onto his knees on the cracked court, gasping in breathless exhaustion as his tired dark brown eyes return.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine... maine Min-Jae ko pehchan liya...

panels.shot: masked watcher on library roof cliffhanger
panels.action: From the roof of the 10-story university library, a mysterious figure in a crimson demon mask and black cloak watches Ha-Jun with a sinister smile: 'Asmodaius ka beej... aakhir kaar poori tarah jaag gaya.'

dialogue.text: Asmodaius ka beej... aakhir kaar jaag gaya.
